critical_findings: Capability holder can mint a newly registered capability using exposed type and key.
Canonical result can be replaced after final M1284 validation and before inherited publish; a stale-identity annex is sealed.
high_findings: Two capabilities for one completed result can publish to two caller-supplied annex paths.
Promoted source-contract claim boundary is accepted because verify_static_authorities checks only schema and source binding.
medium_findings: M1284 payload is emitted with inherited M1278 completion token and seal namespace.
positive_controls: Bool attempt and row counters are rejected.
Same capability second consumption is rejected.
Final checkpoint, schema, Table-A, full-network, system-speedup and headline promotions are rejected.
Missing attempt, seal, PID identity, lock/work consistency and result are rejected.
Result replacement before publish entry is rejected by canonical completion revalidation.

P0: Bind one opaque registry capability to exact canonical result seals and one canonical annex path; expose no key/gate and allow one issuance.
Make no-replace filesystem commit the durable single-use authority and use a zero-argument production publisher.
Revalidate canonical completion inside the atomic M1284 writer immediately before rename and bind staged output to exact digests.
Validate exact closed M1284 contract claims and pin contract identity.
Use M1284-native completion token and seal namespace.
P1: Regress capability minting, multiple issuance, alternate destinations and both TOCTOU windows.
Retain bool-int, final claim/schema and missing-state tests; exact-check module and sequence row schemas.
Require different-author source hammer before one canonical gate run.
P2: Require separate receipt-blind result hammer after one canonical publication.
Keep annex ep35/decoder/diagnostic-only and outside Table-A/system/energy/PPA/headline.
